title: Remove load-dependent test timeouts in the core and OpenCode plugin suites without weakening assertions

environment.workingTree: changes uncommitted; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy performed

before.failure: The cold first plugin import timed out at 20.1s during a full parallel turbo test run; the greeting test failed while the same test passed in isolation.

The 'keeps control-plane files trackable by git' test shells out to `git check-ignore`. It took 7.155s during a full parallel turbo test run (66 files / 775 cases) and failed the default 5s timeout; standalone it took 232ms.

after.change: testTimeout and hookTimeout -> 30_000, with the measured 7.1s cold-run value documented inline

whyThisIsNotWeakening: No test assertion, skip, retry count or coverage threshold changed.
The tests still perform the same real work: the plugin still loads the real DNA/plugin graph, and the core test still executes `git check-ignore` against the real control-plane files.
The timeouts are now above the measured contention envelope instead of below it; a genuinely hanging test still fails after 30s/60s.
The git test already batched all paths into one `git check-ignore` call; the failure was scheduler/AV contention, not an O(n) spawn loop.

focusedCore.command: pnpm --filter @behavior-os/core exec vitest run tests/opencode-config.test.ts -t "keeps control-plane files trackable by git"

fullSuite.result: 8/8 tasks, 66 files / 775 cases, 0 cached; core 41/470, schemas 4/34, sdk 2/11, cli 3/20, mcp 4/36, orchestrator 3/64, plugin 8/136, examples 1/4

verifyAll.result: all 9 gates passed; test task replayed the successful 66/775 cache entry

limitations: The underlying cause is environment contention (parallel turbo tasks, Windows Git startup and antivirus scanning), not an application defect; the timeouts make the suite deterministic within the measured envelope, they do not make the machine faster.
A future machine that is substantially slower than the measured 7.1s contention could still exceed 30s; the inline comment records the measurement so the next adjuster has evidence.
Docker is not installed in this environment, so the container image was not built or run.
Release automation remains human-gated and unverified; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy was performed.
notDone: git commit, merge, push, tag, publish or deploy
